actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 2026 年 8 月（8 月 1 日至 9 月 1 日）青禾在当前合成测试库范围内的整体统计结果为：有效订单均额 37.15 元/单；购买会员人均消费 66.87 元/账户；购买频次 1.8 单/账户；单均商品件数约 1.22 件/单。以上为汇总口径，未按门店分组，也未附加额外筛选；人数按 CRM 会员账户统计。金额已由分换算为元并保留两位小数。本轮四项指标均有返回值，未出现分母为零导致的未定义。
actual.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的有效订单均额、购买会员人均消费、购买频次和单均商品件数是多少？

name: ratio_as_percent
note: 比例误作百分数：购买频次乘 100
